evidence.reason: The code compares only sets of line text: `published_added ∩ head_removed` and `published_removed ∩ head_added`, with no path, hunk, or line-number/location component. The diff parser above discards hunk positions, so an unrelated later deletion of an identically indented line in another function is falsely reported as undoing the published change. That can make `merge_head_evidence` raise and prevent reconciliation/write-back. This is an implementation defect in existing behavior, not a request for a new requirement.
